blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robot policies increasingly incorporate semantic reasoning and future-world prediction, yet combining these capabilities does not guarantee that local predictions and actions remain aligned with task progress. We introduce CogWAM, a cognition-guided world-action model that establishes an explicit semantic interface between task reasoning and world-action learning through a persistent Semantic State, which stores completed task events and the active subtask. CogWAM updates this state only when observations indicate semantic transitions, allowing task-level context to persist across multiple action chunks. To bridge semantic context with physical prediction and control, CogWAM employs progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries that selectively extract task-relevant information for future-world prediction and action generation. During training, the Semantic State provides shared task-progress context for both branches, while inference removes the future-prediction branch and directly generates actions from observations and the maintained state. We further introduce semantic training strategies to improve transition learning and closed-loop conditioning. Without additional robot-action pretraining, CogWAM achieves 15.56 / 11.70% Score/SR on RoboDojo and state-of-the-art performance on BiCoord, while real-world experiments demonstrate closed-loop dual-arm manipulation with 16.4× fewer Semantic State regenerations than step-wise updating.
blocks.zh: 机器人政策越来越多地纳入语义推理和未来世界的预测,但结合这些能力并不能保证当地的预测和行动仍然与任务进展相一致。 我们引入了CogWAM,这是一种认知指导的世界行动模式,它通过一个持久的语义状态在任务推理和世界行动学习之间建立了明确的语义界面,它存储已完成的任务事件和活跃的子任务. CogWAM 仅在观测显示语义过渡时更新此状态,允许任务级上下文在多个动作块之间持久存在. 为了将语义上的内容与物理预测和控制联系起来,CogWAM采用有进度条件的世界和行动查询,有选择地为未来世界的预测和行动生成提取与任务有关的信息。 在培训期间,语义国为两个分支提供共享的任务进度背景,而推论则删除未来预测分支,直接从观察和保持状态中产生行动. 我们进一步推行语义培训策略,以改善过渡学习和闭路调节. 在不增加机器人动作预训的情况下,CogWAM在RoboDojo上达到15.56/11.70%的分数/SR,在BiCoord上达到最先进的性能,而现实世界的实验则显示闭路双臂操纵,语义状态再生比逐步更新要少16.4×.

blocks.en: \calmregular Introduction
blocks.zh: 调谐 导言

blocks.en: The promise of physical intelligence lies in embodied agents that can transform abstract intentions into purposeful changes in the physical world ( Ahn et al., 2022 ; Brooks, 1991 ; Driess et al., 2023 ; Black et al., 2025 ) . Doing so requires more than predicting isolated actions. As interaction unfolds, a robot needs task-level cognition to relate what has already been accomplished to what should happen next, while grounding its evolving intent in physical interaction ( Huang et al., 2022 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . Robot policies should therefore connect task semantics, execution progress, and physical dynamics within a unified closed loop.
blocks.zh: 身体智能的希望在于能够将抽象意图转化为物质世界有目的变化的内在物剂(Ahn等人,2022年;Brooks,1991年;Driesss等人,2023年;Black等人,2025年)。 这样做不仅需要预测孤立的行动。 随着相互作用的展开,机器人需要任务层面的认识,才能将已经取得的成就与今后应发生的情况联系起来,同时将其不断发展的意图建立在物理相互作用上(Huang等人,2022年;Shi等人,2025年)。 因此,机器人政策应该将任务语义、执行进展和物理动态在一个统一的封闭循环中联系起来。

blocks.en: Current robot foundation models have advanced complementary parts of this loop. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) leverage large-scale vision-language pretraining to achieve strong semantic understanding and multi-task generalization ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2024 ) . Recent approaches further introduce high-level reasoning, temporal memory, and subtask prediction to better track execution progress ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Su et al., 2026a ) . In parallel, world-action models (WAMs) augment action learning with predictions of future world representations, providing supervision for spatial change and interaction dynamics ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026a ; Lyu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Together, these directions address what should be accomplished next and how physical interaction may evolve. However, incorporating both capabilities does not by itself specify how task progress should be represented, maintained, and shared between them. A locally plausible scene prediction or action may still correspond to a subtask that has already been completed or has not yet been reached. This motivates a shared representation of task progress that both branches can condition on and that is revised in response to observed progress.
blocks.zh: 目前机器人基础模型有这个循环的高级互补部分. 视觉语言动作模型(VLAs)利用大规模视觉语言预训,实现强烈的语义理解和多任务概括(Kim等人,2025年;Black等人,2024年). 最近的方法进一步引入了高层次的推理,时间记忆和子任务预测,以便更好地跟踪执行进度(Shi等人,2025年;Shi等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Su等人,2026年a). 同时,世界行动模型(WAMS)用对未来世界表现的预测增强行动学习,为空间变化和相互作用动态提供监督(Zhu等人,2025年;Ye等人,2026年a;Lyu等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年a;赵等人,2026年a;Li等人,2026年a;张等人,2026年a). 这些方向共同涉及下一步应当完成的工作以及物理互动可能如何演变。 然而,纳入这两种能力本身并不说明应如何反映、维持和分担任务的进展。 当地可信的场景预测或行动仍可能与一个已完成或尚未达到的子任务相对应。 这促使两个处共同反映任务进展,这两个处可以加以制约,并根据观察到的进展加以修订。

blocks.en: To address this alignment problem, we introduce CogWAM (Fig. 1 ), which explicitly represents task progress as a persistent cognitive state rather than repeatedly inferring it from individual observations Yang et al. (2026) . Existing hierarchical and memory-based policies demonstrate the importance of maintaining temporal context for long-horizon execution ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Torne et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , yet they primarily focus on semantic reasoning or memory accumulation without explicitly coupling task progress with predictive world modeling and action generation. CogWAM addresses this gap through a persistent Semantic State that records completed task events and the active subtask. During execution, the state is updated only when observations indicate meaningful task transitions, allowing semantic context to persist across multiple action chunks. This event-driven formulation decouples the semantic timescale from the control timescale: actions require frequent replanning for reactive control ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) , whereas task semantics evolve only at a small number of stage transitions ( Torne et al., 2026 ; Sutton et al., 1999 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了CogWAM(图1),它明确表明任务进展是一个持久的认知状态,而不是从个人观察杨等人(2026年)中反复推断出来。 现有的分级和基于记忆的政策表明,必须维持长期处决的时间背景(Shi等人,2025年;Shi等人,2026年;Torne等人,2026年;Yang等人,2025年),但它们主要侧重于语义推理或记忆积累,而没有明确地将任务进展与预测的世界模型和行动生成结合起来。 CogWAM通过一个持久的语义状态来解决这一空白,该状态记录已完成的任务事件和正在运行的子任务. 在执行期间,只有当观察显示有意义的任务过渡时,状态才会更新,允许语义上下文在多个动作块间持续存在. 这种由事件驱动的配体使语义定时表与控制时表脱钩:行动需要频繁地重新规划反应性控制(Zhao等人,2023年),而任务语义只在少量阶段过渡中演化(Torne等人,2026年;Sutton等人,1999年).

blocks.en: Beyond maintaining task progress, an effective interface must also determine how semantic context is transferred to different physical objectives. Future-world prediction and action generation optimize different objectives, requiring representations that capture scene evolution and executable control. CogWAM therefore introduces progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries, which are conditioned on the same Semantic State while selectively extracting branch-specific information for future multi-view latent prediction and continuous action generation. This allows task-level semantics to be shared while preserving objective-specific representations Li et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 除了保持任务进度外,有效的界面还必须确定语义上下文如何转移到不同的物理目标. 未来世界的预测和动作生成优化了不同的目标,要求表现能够捕捉场景演化和可执行控制. 因此,CogWAM引入了以进展为条件的世界和行动查询,这些查询以同一语义状态为条件,同时有选择地为未来的多视角潜在预测和连续行动生成提取分部门信息。 这使得任务层次的语义可以共享,同时保留了针对特定目标的表述Li等人(2023年).

blocks.en:
This state-conditioned formulation introduces two training challenges. First, semantic transitions are sparse relative to state persistence, causing imbalance between UPDATE and KEEP decisions. Second, training with annotated states creates exposure bias because closed-loop execution relies on predicted states Bengio et al. (2015) . We address these issues with boundary-aware semantic supervision and progressive semantic conditioning.
Our main contributions are summarized as follows: 1. We present CogWAM, a semantics-aware world-action architecture that couples a persistent Semantic State with progress-conditioned WORLD/ACTION queries, enabling task-progress-aware future prediction and control. 2. We develop event-triggered semantic planning, which decouples semantic evolution from control frequency, together with training strategies that address sparse transitions and closed-loop semantic conditioning. 3. We demonstrate that explicit semantic interface design consistently improves robot policies across simulation, real-world, and different world-action architectures.
blocks.zh:
这种有条件的提法提出了两个培训挑战。 首先,相对于国家的持久性而言,语义上的过渡是很少的,造成UPDATE和KEEP决定之间的不平衡. 第二,与附加说明的状态进行训练会造成暴露偏差,因为闭路处决依赖于预测的状态Bengio等人(2015年)。 我们通过边界意识语义监督和渐进语义调节来解决这些问题。
我们的主要贡献概述如下: 1. 我们介绍CogWAM,这是一个意识到世界行动的语义结构,它与一个持久的语义国家结合,提出有进步条件的世界/ACTION问题,从而能够了解任务的进展——未来的预测和控制。 2. 我们制定事件触发语义规划,将语义演化与控制频率脱钩,同时制定培训战略,解决零星过渡和闭锁语义调节问题。 3. 我们表明,明确的语义界面设计不断改进机器人政策,跨越模拟、现实世界和不同世界行动架构。

blocks.en: \calmregular Related Work
blocks.zh: 调谐 有关工作

blocks.en:
Vision-Language-Action Models and Long-Horizon Reasoning. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for language-conditioned robotic control ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Recent work increasingly augments such policies with higher-level reasoning and temporal context. π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} incorporates high-level semantic prediction to support open-world and long-horizon manipulation ( Black et al., 2025 ) , while Hi Robot explicitly decomposes high-level semantic reasoning and low-level visuomotor execution ( Shi et al., 2025 ) . MemoryVLA introduces perceptual–cognitive memory for temporally dependent control ( Shi et al., 2026 ) , and Mem maintains multi-scale embodied memory across an episode ( Torne et al., 2026 ) . SeqVLA explicitly predicts subtask completion to control transitions during sequential manipulation ( Yang et al., 2025 ) .
These works demonstrate the importance of reasoning beyond the current observation and global instruction. CogWAM similarly models execution progress, but differs by explicitly transferring maintained task progress into world-action learning through a structured semantic interface.
blocks.zh:
愿景-语言-行动模式与长视理性. Vision-Langage-Action(VLA)模型为语言条件的机器人控制利用经过预先培训的视觉语言表现(Brohan等人,2023年;Kim等人,2024年;Kim等人,2025年;Zheng等人,2026年). 最近的工作越来越多地以更高层次的推理和时间背景来强化这些政策。 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5} 包含高级语义预测以支持开放世界和长视线操纵(Black等人,2025年),而Hi Robot则明确分解高级语义推理和低等维乌莫托尔处决(Shi等人,2025年). MemoryVLA为时间依赖性控制引入了感知-认知记忆(Shi等人,2026年),Mem在整个一集中保持多尺度的内存(Torne等人,2026年). SeqVLA明确预测子任务的完成,以控制顺序操纵过程中的过渡(Yang等人,2025年).
这些著作表明了在目前观察和全球指示之外进行推理的重要性。 CogWAM类似的模型执行进度,但不同之处在于通过结构化的语义界面,将维持的任务进度明确转移到世界动作学习中.

blocks.en:
World-Action Models and Predictive Robot Policies. WAMs augment action learning with predictive models of future scene evolution Du et al. (2023) . Unified World Models jointly model future observations and actions ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , while DreamZero scales this paradigm and demonstrates strong zero-shot physical generalization ( Ye et al., 2026a ) . Recent studies increasingly question whether dense future video generation is necessary. Fast-WAM shows that world-model co-training can provide substantial benefits even without explicit future generation at inference time ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, recent approaches move toward compact, action-relevant future representations: LaWAM predicts latent visual subgoals that condition robot actions ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , whereas SG-WAM models future dynamics directly in a geometry-aware policy representation space ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
CogWAM follows this trend toward control-relevant future representations, while conditioning future prediction on an explicit execution-aware Semantic State.
blocks.zh:
世界行动模式和预测机器人政策。 WAMs用未来场景演化的预测模型增强动作学习(2023年). United World Models联合模拟未来的观察和行动(Zhu等人,2025年),而DreamZero衡量这一范式,并显示强烈的零射物理概括(Ye等人,2026a). 最近的研究越来越质疑今后是否有必要制作密集的视频。 Fast-WAM显示,即使没有在推断时间明确的未来世代,世界模式的协同培训也能提供巨大的好处(袁等人,2026年). 与此同时,最近的办法走向紧凑、与行动相关的未来表述: LaWAM预测潜在的视觉次级目标,将机器人行动作为条件(Chen等人,2026a),而SG-WAM模型则直接在几何感知的政策代表空间中模拟未来的动态(Zhao等人,2026年)。
CogWAM遵循这种与控制相关的未来表述的趋势,同时将未来的预测以明确的处决意识语义状态为条件。

blocks.en: Task Progress across Semantic and Control Timescales. A related challenge is the mismatch between task-level semantics and the finer temporal scale of physical control. Hierarchical VLAs address this issue through intermediate semantic commands ( Shi et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2025 ) , while completion-aware approaches track task progress across action chunks ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . WALL-WM further organizes world-action learning around semantically coherent events to address the granularity mismatch among language, visual dynamics, and fixed-length actions ( Li et al., 2026b ) . CogWAM instead decouples Semantic State transitions from fixed-horizon action generation: the state persists across multiple replanning cycles and is updated only when observed progress indicates a semantic transition. This formulation is related to temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning ( Sutton et al., 1999 ) , but operates on a language-level task state whose updates are event-triggered by execution progress ( Tabuada, 2007 ) .
blocks.zh: 跨越语义和控制时间尺度的任务进度 。 一个相关的挑战是任务层次语义与物理控制更细化的时间尺度之间的不匹配. 分级的VLA通过中间语义指令(Shi等人,2025年;Black等人,2025年)来解决这一问题,而完成意识方法则跟踪跨行动块的任务进展(Yang等人,2025年)。 WALL-WM还围绕精准一致的事件组织世界行动学习,以解决语言、视觉动态和固定长度行动之间的颗粒性不匹配问题(Li等人,2026b)。 CogWAM转而将语义状态从固定范围行动生成中解开:该状态持续跨越多个重新规划周期,只有在观察到的进展表明语义转变时才更新。 这种提法与强化学习中的时间抽象(Sutton等人,1999年)有关,但运行在语言一级的任务状态上,其更新由执行进度触发(Tabuada,2007年).

blocks.en:
Agentic Orchestration and System-1/System-2 Robot Policies. A growing line of work moves beyond improving a single visuomotor policy and instead couples fast learned control with slower foundation-model reasoning, forming an emerging System-1/System-2 paradigm for robot decision making. HarnessWAM places a VLM-based task manager above a WAM to maintain global task state and trigger deliberation when needed ( Gu et al., 2026 ) ; VLAs-as-Tools lets a high-level VLM invoke specialized VLA policies as executable tools with progress-aware replanning ( Lei et al., 2026 ) ; and recent studies of hierarchical VLA agents systematically examine how planner–controller interfaces, memory, and switching mechanisms affect long-horizon execution ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . More general agentic systems further extend this idea to policy routing, recovery, and autonomous policy improvement ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ) .
At the other extreme, frontier multimodal models have been directly deployed as closed-loop robot policies: GPT-6 Astra is evaluated across all 42 RoboDojo tasks ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , while concurrent GPT-as-Policy work explores a hybrid setting in which Astra selectively reviews and corrects trajectories generated by a pretrained π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} controller ( Su et al., 2026b ) .
Collectively, these systems reflect a broader shift from monolithic robot policies toward architectures that separate high-level semantic reasoning from high-frequency sensorimotor control. CogWAM follows the same separation of semantic and physical timescales, but takes a different route: rather than keeping System-2 reasoning as an external agent that repeatedly plans, routes, or corrects a downstream policy, CogWAM compresses its output into a persistent Semantic State and makes that state part of the learned world-action interface, allowing semantic cognition to persist across multiple System-1 control cycles without being recomputed at every step.
blocks.zh:
代理管弦乐和系统1/系统2机器人政策. 越来越多的工作范围超越了改进单一的维乌莫托尔政策,而是用较慢的基础模型推理,夫妇们快速学习了控制,形成了一个新兴的System-2模式,用于机器人决策. HarnessWAM将基于VLM的任务管理器置于WAM之上,以保持全球任务状态,并在需要时触发审议(Gu等人,2026年);VLAS-as-Tools允许一个高级VLM援引专门的VLA政策作为可执行的工具,进行进步意识的重新规划(Lei等人,2026年);最近对分级VLA代理人的研究系统地审查规划者-控制器接口、内存和切换机制如何影响长视距执行(Hu等人,2026年)。 更一般的代理系统将这一想法进一步扩展到政策路线、恢复和自主政策改进(Huang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年c).
在另一个极端,前沿多式联运模式被作为闭路机器人政策直接部署:GPT-6 Astra被评价到所有42项RoboDojo任务(Zhang等人,2026b)中,同时进行的GPT-as-Policy工作探索一种混合环境,在这种环境中,Astra有选择地审查并纠正预先训练好的 0.5\pi_{0.5}控制器产生的轨迹(Su等人,2026b)。
这些系统集体地反映了从单体机器人政策向将高级语义推理与高频感应控制区分开的架构的更广泛的转变. CogWAM遵循相同的语义和物理时间尺度分离,但走不同的路线: 与其将System-2推理作为外部代理人,反复计划,路线,或纠正下游政策,CogWAM将其输出压缩成一个持久的语义状态,并使该状态成为所学的世界-动作界面的一部分,允许语义认知在多个System-1控制周期中持久存在,而不在每个步骤中重新计算.

blocks.en: CogWAM maintains a persistent Semantic State throughout task execution and updates it only when visual evidence indicates a change in task progress. As a language-level summary of execution progress, the Semantic State preserves task history that may no longer be recoverable from the current observation. Instead of regenerating semantic context at every step Yang et al. (2026) , CogWAM separates transition detection from state generation.

blocks.en: \calmregular Progress-Conditioned World–Action Interface
blocks.zh: \ calm 定期进度 - 有条件的世界 - 行动接口

blocks.en: Maintaining task progress alone does not determine how semantic context should influence different physical prediction objectives. Future-world prediction and action generation capture complementary aspects of robot behavior: the former models scene evolution, while the latter generates executable control trajectories. CogWAM therefore introduces progress-conditioned WORLD and ACTION queries to transfer the same task-progress context to both branches while preserving objective-specific representations.
blocks.zh: 单靠维持任务进展不能决定语义背景应如何影响不同的物理预测目标. 未来世界的预测和行动生成捕捉机器人行为的互补方面:前模型场景演化,而后模型生成可执行控制轨迹. 因此,协会提出了有进展条件的世界和行动查询,将同样的任务进展背景转移到两个处,同时保留针对具体目标的说明。

The resulting hidden representations 𝑯 t w \bm{H}_{t}^{w} and 𝑯 t a \bm{H}_{t}^{a} are generated by the WORLD and ACTION queries: 𝑯 t w , 𝑯 t a = f θ ​ ( 𝒪 t , ℓ , S t , Q w , Q a ) . \bm{H}_{t}^{w},\bm{H}_{t}^{a}=f_{\theta}(\mathcal{O}_{t},\ell,S_{t},Q^{w},Q^{a}). (5) The causal ordering allows both query sets to attend to the current observation, instruction, and Semantic State, while their outputs are routed to different downstream objectives. Specifically, 𝑯 t w \bm{H}_{t}^{w} conditions future multi-view latent prediction, whereas 𝑯 t a \bm{H}_{t}^{a} conditions continuous action generation. Their branch-specific supervision encourages the WORLD and ACTION queries to extract task-relevant information for their respective prediction targets, enabling shared task-level semantics with specialized physical representations.
This design is supported by the gradient analysis in Appendix 5.1.1 , which shows that World and Action objectives share perceptual grounding but require increasingly distinct representations at the query readout stage.

World and Action Branches. CogWAM instantiates the world and action branches as two streams in a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture ( Liang et al., 2024 ) . Both streams share 𝒵 t \mathcal{Z}_{t} as the current visual anchor and interact through multimodal self-attention, while retaining modality-specific cross-attention and feed-forward blocks. The World stream predicts 𝒵 t + H \mathcal{Z}_{t+H} conditioned on 𝑯 t w \bm{H}_{t}^{w} , whereas the Action stream generates 𝒂 t \bm{a}_{t} conditioned on 𝑯 t a \bm{H}_{t}^{a} .
During joint training, a structured attention mask prevents Action tokens from attending to future-latent tokens, avoiding target leakage and ensuring that action generation uses only information available at inference Yuan et al. (2026) . Future-latent prediction therefore serves as a training-time co-objective rather than an intermediate plan for action generation. At inference, the World stream is removed, leaving a direct action path conditioned on 𝒵 t \mathcal{Z}_{t} and 𝑯 t a \bm{H}_{t}^{a} .

blocks.en: Boundary-Aware Semantic Sampling. Semantic transitions are sparse, so uniform sampling strongly favors KEEP . We therefore oversample UPDATE events together with hard- KEEP examples near annotated transition boundaries. These neighboring observations are visually similar to transition states but do not yet justify advancing the subtask, encouraging the model to localize semantic transitions more precisely. This rebalancing is applied only to semantic supervision; world and action training follow the original demonstration distribution.
blocks.zh: 边界-意识语义采样. 语义上的转变是稀少的, 所以统一采样非常有利于KEEP。 因此,我们过多地总结了最近的活动,以及附加说明的过渡边界附近的困难事例。 这些相邻的观测在视觉上与过渡状态相似,但尚不能证明推进子任务有理,鼓励模式更准确地将语义过渡本地化. 这种再平衡仅适用于语义监督;世界和行动培训遵循最初的演示分发.

blocks.en: Progressive Semantic Conditioning. Training the world and action branches only with annotated Semantic States creates a train–inference mismatch, since deployment conditions on model-predicted states. We therefore use the predicted state S ^ t \widehat{S}_{t} as semantic context with probability ρ k \rho_{k} and the annotated state S t ⋆ S_{t}^{\star} otherwise, where ρ k \rho_{k} increases with training progress k k . Semantic prediction remains supervised by the annotated target; only the context used to construct 𝑯 t w \bm{H}_{t}^{w} and 𝑯 t a \bm{H}_{t}^{a} is progressively replaced. This exposes both branches to the semantic context encountered during closed-loop inference.
blocks.zh: 进步语义条件. 训练世界和行动部门只与附加说明的语义国家进行,造成火车-推论不匹配,因为部署条件在模型预测的国家。 因此,我们使用预言状态 S ^ t\glash{S}_{t} 作为语义上下文, 概率为 ^ k\rho_{k} 和附加说明状态 S t → S_{t}^{\star} 否则, 训练进度为 k k k\rho_{k} 增加。 语义预测仍然由注释目标监督;只有用于构建H t w\bm{H}_{t}^{w}和H t a\bm{H}_{t}^{a}的上下文被逐渐替换. 这让两个分支都暴露在闭路推理过程中遇到的语义上下文.

blocks.en: We evaluate CogWAM in both simulation and the real world. Following a question-driven evaluation protocol, our experiments are designed to answer the following four questions: Q1: How does CogWAM perform on multi-task robotic manipulation benchmarks? Q2: Does the Semantic State improve long-horizon manipulation? Q3: How should the Semantic State be updated during closed-loop execution? Q4: How well does CogWAM transfer to real-world robotic manipulation?
blocks.zh: 我们在模拟和现实世界中评价CogWAM。 按照一个以问题驱动的评价规程,我们的实验旨在回答以下四个问题: 问题1:CogWAM在多任务机器人操纵基准上的表现如何? 问题2:语义国是否改进长视线操纵?. 问题3:闭关死刑执行期间应如何更新语义状态?. 问题4:CogWAM转战现实世界机器人操控有多好?.

blocks.en: Benchmarks. We conduct simulation experiments on RoboDojo Chen et al. (2026b) and BiCoord Peng et al. (2026) , both under the multi-task setting. RoboDojo evaluates manipulation capabilities across Generalization, Precision, Long-Horizon, Memory, and Open categories. BiCoord contains 18 long-horizon bimanual tasks with stage-wise annotations and an average of 4.27 stages per task, providing a complementary test bed for multi-stage bimanual coordination.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们在多任务设定下对RoboDojo Chen等人(2026b)和BiCoord Peng等人(2026)进行模拟试验。 RoboDojo评价了跨通用,精密,长视,记忆,和开放类的操纵能力. BiCoord包含18项长视双人任务,有阶段性说明,每个任务平均4.27个阶段,为多阶段双人协调提供了补充测试床.

blocks.en: Metrics. For RoboDojo, we report Score and Success Rate (SR) for each capability dimension and average them across the five dimensions. Following the official protocol, each task is evaluated over 50 episodes; Generalization uses 25 standard and 25 randomized episodes. For BiCoord, we report task Success Rate (SR) and Stage-wise Success Rate (SSR) over 100 rollouts per task. For the update-strategy analysis, we additionally report semantic-model calls, inference latency, and transition delay relative to annotated stage boundaries, measured in the real-robot deployment where the control frequency imposes a fixed replanning budget.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 对于RoboDojo,我们报告每个能力层面的得分和成功率,并在五个层面进行平均。 根据官方协议,每个任务评价超过50集;通用使用25个标准集和25个随机集. 对于双科,我们报告任务成功率(SR)和分阶段成功率(SSR),每任务超过100次。 关于更新-战略分析,我们另外报告语义-模型调用、推论延迟以及相对于附加说明的阶段界限的过渡延迟,以实际机器人部署计量,因为控制频率规定了固定的重新规划预算。

Interface and Representation Analysis. We further analyze two design choices underlying CogWAM: whether the proposed semantic interface transfers across world-action architectures, and how the predictive representation affects performance.
(1) Cross-architecture transfer.
Applying the same semantic interface to Fast-WAM Yuan et al. (2026) improves its average Score/SR from 3.48/2.03% to 13.33/9.40% , while retaining the original Fast-WAM world-action formulation.
This substantial gain shows that the benefit of the semantic interface is not specific to CogWAM’s underlying WAM architecture.
(2) Predictive representation and model efficiency. We compare predictive formulations while keeping the semantic interface unchanged. Fast-WAM repurposes a pretrained Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video backbone Wan (2025) , whereas CogWAM predicts future DINOv3 features with a 0.44B world stream trained from scratch. Despite the reduced world-modeling capacity, CogWAM improves average Score/SR from 13.33/9.40% to 15.56/11.70% , with gains on Generalization, Precision, and Long-Horizon, while Wan2.2 remains stronger on Memory. This suggests that control-relevant visual representations can provide effective predictive supervision without large generative backbones. Since representation, capacity, and initialization differ jointly, we interpret this comparison as evidence of formulation efficiency rather than isolated representation quality.

blocks.en: Q2: Effect of the Semantic State. We isolate the contribution of the Semantic State by comparing CogWAM with a world-action MoT counterpart that shares the same backbone and training setting but conditions on only the current observation and global task instruction, without any persistent Semantic State. As illustrated in Fig. 3 , this baseline is more prone to subtask drift, repetition of completed stages, and premature transitions. In contrast, CogWAM preserves the active subtask across multiple action chunks and advances it only when execution progress changes. Fig. 4 further quantifies these gains on the Long-Horizon and Memory categories of RoboDojo and the stage-wise progression metrics of BiCoord.
blocks.zh: 问题2:语义国的影响。 我们孤立语义国的贡献,将CogWAM与一个具有相同骨干和培训背景、但只具备当前观察和全球任务指示的条件的世界行动部对应方进行比较,而没有任何持续的语义国。 如图3所示,这一基线更容易发生子任务漂移、重复完成阶段和过早过渡的情况。 相比之下,CogWAM在多个动作块中保留了活动子任务,只有在执行进度发生变化时才会推进. 图4进一步量化了在RoboDojo的Long-Horizon和记忆类别以及BiCoord的阶段性进展指标方面的这些进展。

blocks.en: Q3: Semantic State update strategies. We compare three update strategies: Synchronous , Asynchronous , and our Event-triggered update. Synchronous updating regenerates the Semantic State at every replanning step and therefore incurs substantial computation. Asynchronous updating reduces this overhead by running the semantic planner at a fixed lower frequency, but its updates can be misaligned with actual subtask transitions. CogWAM instead performs a lightweight KEEP / UPDATE decision and regenerates the Semantic State only when a semantic transition is detected. As shown in Fig. 4 , the event-triggered strategy performs best on both benchmarks; notably, synchronous updating does not surpass asynchronous updating despite regenerating far more often, indicating that update timing matters more than update frequency. We further compare semantic-model calls, inference latency, and transition delay on the real robot (Sec. 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 问题3:语义状态更新策略. 我们比较三个更新策略:同步,同步,以及我们事件触发的更新. 同步更新在每一个重新规划步骤上重新生成语义状态,因此需要进行大量的计算。 同步更新通过在固定的低频运行语义计划器来减少这种高空运行,但其更新可能与实际的子任务过渡错配. CogWAM 代替执行轻量级 KKEE / UPDATE 的决定,只有在检测到语义过渡时才能重新生成语义状态. 如图4所示,事件触发战略在两个基准上表现最好;特别是,同步更新不会超过同步更新,尽管重现频率要多得多,这表明更新的时间比更新频率更重要。 我们进一步比较语义模型调用,推论延迟,以及真机器人的过渡延迟(第4.3节).

We further assess robustness under four controlled distribution shifts, each evaluated independently across all six tasks. For each shift dimension, we perform 5 closed-loop trials per task, yielding 30 trials per dimension. Tab. 3 summarizes the successful trials across both settings. We additionally visualize a representative Place in Bag rollout, showing the predicted KEEP / UPDATE decisions and corresponding subtask memory in Fig. 3 .

blocks.en: Real-time efficiency of semantic updating. The real robot runs a 30 Hz control loop and issues one replanning request every 10 control steps, leaving a 333 ms budget per replanning step. On Place in Bag , five held-out rollouts average 21.6 s, 65.4 replanning steps, and 4.00 semantic transitions per episode. As shown in Tab. 4 , synchronous updating achieves a 152 ms transition delay but incurs 927.8 ms latency, exceeding the budget by 2.8 × 2.8\times . Asynchronous updating reduces latency to 309.3 ms by updating every 30 control steps, but increases transition delay to 502 ms. In contrast, CogWAM evaluates the KEEP / UPDATE decision at every replanning step, as frequently as synchronous updating, but requires 16.4 × 16.4\times fewer Semantic State regenerations. The KEEP / UPDATE decision is predicted from the semantic module’s final hidden state without autoregressive decoding, enabling frequent transition checks at low cost. This yields the same 152 ms transition delay as synchronous updating, while reducing inference latency from 927.8 ms to 146.7 ms.

KEEP / UPDATE的决定是从语义模块的最终隐藏状态中预言的,没有自动解码,使得能够以低成本进行频繁的过渡检查. 这产生与同步更新相同的152 ms的过渡延迟,同时将推断延迟从927.8 ms降低到146.7 ms.

blocks.en: CogWAM bridges high-level semantic reasoning and low-level physical control through a structured World–Action interface, adding a predictive World branch alongside the Action branch that conventional policies optimize alone ( Black et al., 2025 ) . This section asks why the two branches need separate queries (§ 5.1.1 ), what future-world prediction contributes beyond direct action supervision (§ 5.1.2 ), and whether the interface transfers to a different World–Action backbone (§ 5.1.3 ).
blocks.zh: CogWAM通过结构化的World-Action接口连接高层次语义推理和低层次的物理控制,与常规政策单独优化的Action分支(Black等人,2025年)一起增加一个预测性的世界分支. 本节询问这两个分支为何需要单独查询(第5.1.1节),未来世界的预测除了直接行动监督(第5.1.2节)之外还有哪些贡献,以及接口是否转移到不同的世界行动主干线(第5.1.3节)。

blocks.en: \calmregular Semantic Interface between VLM and World-Action Learning
blocks.zh: \ calm 常规语义介面 VLM 与世界行动学习

blocks.en: Future-world prediction and action generation share the same instruction and observation, but supervise the model through different output modalities: one learns a representation of scene evolution, the other a representation of executable control. Two design questions follow. How deep into the shared VLM should the objectives remain coupled, and through which interface should each read out the representation it needs? We answer both by measuring, rather than assuming, how the two objectives interact inside the trunk.
blocks.zh: 未来世界的预测和动作生成共享相同的指令和观测,但通过不同的输出模式来监督模型:一个学习场景演化的表示,另一个学习可执行控制的表现. 下面是两个设计问题。 是否应该把目标结合起来,通过何种接口,各方应宣读各自需要的表述? 我们通过衡量而不是假设两个目标如何在树干内部相互作用来回答这两个问题。

blocks.en: Shared grounding, specialized abstraction. Sec. 3.3 motivates separate WORLD and ACTION queries as a way to share task-level semantics while preserving objective-specific representations; the gradients make that trade-off measurable. In CogWAM the objectives are positively but weakly aligned throughout the trunk, and the alignment decreases with depth (Fig. 6 a): every interval excludes zero, and the medians fall monotonically from 0.182 ​ [ 0.124 , 0.282 ] 0.182\,[0.124,0.282] in the visual tower through 0.101 0.101 and 0.087 0.087 to 0.047 ​ [ 0.023 , 0.080 ] 0.047\,[0.023,0.080] in the last language-model third ( 0.081 0.081 over the trunk as a whole). Because the blocks are measured on the same batches, a paired test applies; the visual tower exceeds every language-model block (Wilcoxon p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ), and LM-early exceeds LM-late; the median of the batch-wise paired differences is 0.023 ​ [ 0.011 , 0.046 ] 0.023\,[0.011,0.046] , although adjacent blocks are not always separable. This is an expectation over batches rather than a per-batch property: 66% to 76% of batches are positive, so there is no systematic opposition between the objectives, but individual batches do disagree. Both objectives must recover the same objects, geometry and scene state, which makes the perceptual trunk genuinely shared; by the semantic depth at which the queries read out, the representation each requires is largely its own. Notably the deeper blocks receive proportionally more world gradient (Fig. 6 b, MR \mathrm{MR} rising from 0.17 0.17 to 0.53 0.53 ) while agreeing with the action objective less, so the divergence is one of direction rather than of the world signal fading out. A single query would have to summarise two only marginally related requirements within one fixed bottleneck, whereas separate WORLD and ACTION queries let each objective retain the full subspace for roughly 3 × 10 4 3\times 10^{4} additional parameters.

blocks.en: Key Findings: Designing a VLM–World-Action Interface An effective interface should therefore not hand one unified semantic representation to every downstream objective, but preserve shared context at the depth where the objectives agree and let each specialise where that agreement runs out.
blocks.zh: 主要结果:设计一个VLM-世界行动接口 因此,一个有效的界面不应将一个统一的语义表述方式交给每一个下游目标,而应保留目标一致的共同背景,并让每个专门部门在协定未达成的情况下进行。

blocks.en: \calmregular Decomposing CogWAM
blocks.zh: 常规分解 CogWAM

blocks.en:
We next decompose CogWAM into the two additions that distinguish it from action-only control: predictive world supervision and semantic conditioning. Tab. 5 follows the progression Action MoT → \rightarrow MoT → \rightarrow CogWAM .
Action MoT retains the World–Action architecture but is trained only with the action objective. MoT additionally learns to predict future observations in the frozen DINO feature space. CogWAM further introduces the semantic interface, which conditions the policy on VLM-derived task progress and maintains an event-triggered Semantic State containing the active subtask and accumulated task history.

blocks.en: Future prediction primarily improves perceptual grounding. Moving from Action MoT to MoT raises Generalization by + 3.73 +3.73 and Precision by + 3.04 +3.04 Score, while Long-Horizon changes by only + 0.26 +0.26 . This pattern is consistent with future-world prediction acting mainly as a representation-learning signal: predicting how the scene will evolve encourages the shared representation to preserve objects, geometry, and interaction-relevant visual structure that are useful for selecting the next action. It does not, however, explicitly encode where the robot is within a multi-stage task, and therefore provides little direct mechanism for resolving progress ambiguity over long horizons.

blocks.en: This reduction is most consequential in long-horizon tasks, where perceptually similar states can recur after different histories and therefore require different subsequent actions. The accumulated Semantic State explicitly records which task events have already occurred, reducing this form of history-dependent state aliasing. The same conditioning can nevertheless benefit shorter-horizon Generalization and Precision tasks: specifying the current semantic stage narrows the set of admissible behaviors and gives the action model a more stable task-relevant context, rather than requiring it to infer both task phase and motor command from the observation at every replanning step.
blocks.zh: 这种减少在远期任务中最为明显,在远期任务中,在不同的历史之后,在概念上相似的状态可能再次发生,因此需要不同的后续行动。 累积的语义状态明确记录了已经发生的任务事件,减少了这种依赖历史状态的别名形式. 尽管如此,同样的条件仍可以有利于较短的视距一般化和精密化任务:指定目前的语义阶段会缩小可接受行为的一组,使动作模型具有更稳定的与任务相关的上下文,而不是要求它从每个重新规划步骤的观察中推断任务阶段和运动指令.

blocks.en: Importantly, the MoT-to-CogWAM comparison adds the complete semantic interface—VLM-derived task-progress conditioning together with the event-triggered Semantic State. We therefore attribute the improvement in Tab. 5 to the semantic interface as a whole, rather than claiming that this ablation isolates either component individually. The disproportionately large Long-Horizon gain is consistent with the additional value of explicit task history, but separating current-subtask conditioning from accumulated semantic memory would require a further component-level ablation.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,MoT-to-CogWAM比较增加了完整的语义界面——VLM派生任务进度调节,加上事件触发语义状态。 因此,我们把改进归结为Tab。 5到语义界面整体,而不是声称这种衰减单独隔离任一组件. 过高的Long-Horizon增益与明确的任务历史的额外价值是一致的,但将当前子任务配置与累积语义内存分开,需要进一步的组件级减值.

blocks.en: Unlike generative world models that optimize future reconstruction, CogWAM predicts future representations in a frozen DINO feature space ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) . Future prediction is used only as a training signal, so the World branch need not synthesize pixels at inference time. The compact target instead encourages the shared representation to capture task-relevant scene evolution while keeping the predictive objective lightweight.
blocks.zh: 与优化未来重建的基因世界模型不同,CogWAM预测未来在冻结的DINO特征空间中的表示(Siméoni等人,2025年). 未来预测仅用作训练信号,因此世界分支在推断时间不需要合成像素. 紧凑的目标反而鼓励共享代表来捕捉与任务相关的场景演变,同时保持预测性客观轻量级.

blocks.en: \calmregular Transferability of the CogWAM Interface

blocks.en: The decomposition above evaluates the CogWAM Interface within our DINO-based World–Action formulation. We next ask whether its benefit depends on this particular predictive backbone. To test this, we attach the same interface to Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , while retaining Fast-WAM’s original world-action formulation, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B predictive backbone ( Wan, 2025 ) , and action decoder.
blocks.zh: 上面的分解在我们基于DINO的世界行动方案内评价了CogWAM接口。 我们接下来要问它的好处是否取决于这种特殊的预测性支柱。 为了测试这一点,我们在Fast-WAM(Yuan et al., 2026)中附加了相同的接口,同时保留了Fast-WAM最初的世界动作配方Wan2.2-TI2V-5B预测主干线(Wan, 2025),以及动作解码器.

blocks.en: Adding the CogWAM Interface raises Fast-WAM’s average Score/SR from 3.48 / 2.03 3.48/2.03 to 13.33 / 9.40 13.33/9.40 . The improvement is broad rather than confined to one capability: Generalization increases by + 9.95 +9.95 Score, Precision by + 17.65 +17.65 , Long-Horizon by + 14.55 +14.55 , Memory by + 5.62 +5.62 , and Open by + 1.51 +1.51 . This transfer is important because the underlying predictive model is unchanged; the gain therefore does not rely on CogWAM’s DINO-space future prediction.
blocks.zh: 添加 CogWAM 数据 接口将快速WAM的平均得分/SR从3.48/2.03 3.48/2.03提高到13.33/9.40 13.33/9.40。 改进范围很广,不局限于一种能力:通用增加+9.95+9.95分,精度增加+17.65+17.65分,长视增加+14.55+14.55分,记忆增加+5.62+5.62分,开放增加+1.51+1.51分. 这种转移很重要,因为基本的预测模型没有变化;因此,收益并不依赖于CogWAM的DINO-空间未来预测。

blocks.en: Together with Tab. 5 , the result separates two roles. Predictive world modeling shapes the representation of how the scene may evolve, while the CogWAM Interface conditions action generation on task progress and execution history. In conditional-prediction terms, the former enriches the predictive representation of the observation, whereas the latter supplies an additional task-state variable that narrows the set of plausible continuations. This explains why the interface improves not only Long-Horizon tasks, where history-dependent ambiguity is strongest, but also Generalization and Precision tasks, where explicit task-phase conditioning can reduce ambiguity in the next-action distribution.
blocks.zh: 与Tab. 5一起,结果将两个角色分开. 预测性的世界建模塑造了场景如何演变的体现,而CogWAM接口则为任务进度和执行历史的动作生成提供了条件. 从有条件的预测来看,前者丰富了观察的预测性表现,而后者则提供了额外的任务状态变量,缩小了一套可能延续的内容。 这解释了为什么接口不仅改进了长视野任务,因为依赖历史的模糊性最强,而且改进了通用化和精密化任务,其中明确的任务阶段条件可以减少下一个动作分配中的模糊性.

blocks.en: The remaining gap between Fast-WAM + CogWAM Interface and CogWAM should not be attributed to any single predictive component, since the two systems retain different world-action formulations. The transfer experiment supports the narrower conclusion that the CogWAM Interface is portable: its benefit persists when attached to a substantially different predictive backbone.
blocks.zh: Fast-WAM + CogWAM 之间的剩余差距 接口和CogWAM不应归属于任何单一的预测成分,因为这两个系统保留了不同的世界行动公式。 转移实验支持一个较窄的结论,即CogWAM接口是可移植的:如果连接到一个截然不同的预测主干线上,其好处就持续存在。

blocks.en: \calmregular Language Grounding under Visual Perturbations
blocks.zh: 调谐 在视觉干扰下进行语言定位

blocks.en: While the previous analysis studies how semantic information is transferred from the VLM to the World-Action model, we further investigate whether the CogWAM Interface enables fine-grained language grounding between instructions and visual entities .
blocks.zh: 虽然先前的分析研究了语义信息如何从VLM转移到世界行动模型,但我们进一步调查CogWAM接口是否能够在指令和视觉实体之间建立精细的语言基础。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Language grounding under visual perturbations. CogWAM follows instructions specifying different target pen holders: white, grey, and brown. The grey-holder setting introduces spatial perturbations of the target objects, while the brown-holder setting introduces additional distractor objects. Despite these variations, CogWAM consistently grounds the instructed target and completes the corresponding manipulation behavior.

We vary the target specified by the instruction while keeping the underlying manipulation objective unchanged. The target object is changed among different pen holders with distinct visual appearances, including white, grey, and brown holders. Furthermore, we introduce two types of visual perturbations: spatial rearrangement of the target objects and additional distractor objects in the scene.
blocks.zh: 图7对Fill Pen Holder任务的语文基础进行了质量评估。 我们改变指令中指定的目标,同时保持基本操纵目标不变。 目标对象在具有不同视觉外观,包括白色,灰色,棕色等不同笔架中有所改变. 此外,我们引入了两类视觉扰动:目标物体的空间重排和场景中的额外分散物体.

blocks.en:
CogWAM successfully identifies the instructed target across these variations, demonstrating robust grounding between linguistic descriptions and visual observations. This behavior highlights a capability provided by the VLM Interface beyond task-progress modeling: instead of relying solely on a compact
language embedding associated with demonstrations, the policy receives a semantically grounded representation that explicitly links instructions with the current visual context.
blocks.zh:
CogWAM成功识别了跨越这些变异的指令目标,显示出语言描述和视觉观测之间的牢固基础. 这种行为凸显了VLM接口在任务进度建模之外提供的一种能力:而不是完全依赖紧凑
与演示有关的语言嵌入,政策得到一个有明确基础的表述,明确将指示与当前视觉环境联系起来。

blocks.en: Key Findings: VLM Enables Robust Language Grounding Beyond task-progress modeling, the VLM interface grounds language instructions to visual entities, allowing CogWAM to robustly follow fine-grained references under visual variations.
blocks.zh: 主要调查结果:自愿参与活动 启用强力语言定位超越任务进度模型,VLM接口向视觉实体提供语言指令,允许CogWAM在视觉变异下强力跟踪精细的引用.

blocks.en: \calmregular Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: \ 定期总结和讨论

blocks.en:
CogWAM shows that explicitly aligning semantic task progress with world-action learning improves execution and deployment efficiency. Across simulation and real-world dual-arm manipulation, it consistently improves task completion without prior embodied robot-data pre-training. Importantly, transferring the same semantic interface to Fast-WAM also yields substantial gains, suggesting that the interface is not tied to a particular WAM architecture and can serve as a reusable bridge between VLM-style semantic reasoning and WAM-style predictive learning.
Our analysis further shows that both update timing and predictive representation matter. Event-triggered updating remains aligned with task transitions while requiring far fewer Semantic State regenerations than synchronous updating. Meanwhile, CogWAM’s compact DINO-based predictive formulation provides additional gains over the Fast-WAM-based variant, indicating that semantic alignment and predictive representation are complementary.
A remaining limitation is that the Semantic State is append-only and cannot revise committed semantic errors. Future work could explore uncertainty-aware state revision and broader transfer across heterogeneous VLM and WAM backbones.
blocks.zh:
CogWAM显示,明确将语义任务进度与世界行动学习相结合,可以提高执行和部署效率. 在整个模拟和现实世界双臂操纵过程中,它不断改进任务完成情况,而不事先体现机器人数据预训。 重要的是,将相同的语义界面转移至Fast-WAM也会产生巨大的收益,表明该界面没有与特定的WAM架构挂钩,可以作为VLM风格的语义推理和WAM风格的预测学习之间的可重复使用的桥梁.
我们的分析还表明,更新时间安排和预测代表性都很重要。 事件触发更新仍然与任务过渡相一致,同时需要的语义状态再生远远少于同步更新。 同时,CogWAM的紧凑的DINO预测性配方比基于快速WAM的变体提供了额外的收益,表明语义调和预测性代表是互补的.
剩下的一个限制是语义状态只是附加的,不能修改已承诺的语义错误. 今后的工作可以探索对不确定性认识状态的修订,并更广泛地跨越各种VLM和WAM主干线。

blocks.en: Appendix C Semantic Supervision
blocks.zh: 附录C 监督

blocks.en: This section details the offline procedure that produces the KEEP / UPDATE decision, the memory increment Δ ​ m t \Delta m_{t} , and the active subtask s t s_{t} .
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍生成 KEEP / UPDATE 决定的离线程序, 内存增量 QQ m t\ Delta m_{t}, 以及活动子任务 s t s_{t} 。

blocks.en: Offline subtask annotation. We generate subtask supervision once offline using GPT-5.6 Sol as a fixed VLM annotator. For each episode, we provide sparsely sampled video frames, the task instruction, and a predefined ordered checklist of semantic stages, and ask the annotator to localize the completion boundary of each stage. The predicted boundaries are mapped back to the original video timeline and converted into right-open subtask spans, yielding the frame-level active subtask s t s_{t} . For tasks with an episode-dependent number of stages, such as Arrange Largest Number , the stage count is first inferred from early observations before constructing the checklist. These annotations are fixed before training; GPT-5.6 Sol is used only for offline annotation and is not involved in policy training or inference.
blocks.zh: 离线子任务注释. 我们使用GPT-5.6 Sol作为固定的VLM注释器,生成子任务监视器。 对于每集,我们提供鲜有样本的视频帧,任务指示,以及预订的语义阶段清单,并要求注释员将每个阶段的完成边界定位. 预测的边界被映射回原来的视频时间表,并转换为右侧开放的子任务跨度,产生帧级活动子任务s t s_{t}. 对于依集数而定的阶段数的任务,如Arange Largest Number ,阶段数首先从早期观测中推断出来,然后构建清单. 这些说明在培训前是固定的;GPT-5.6 Sol只用于线下注解,不参与政策培训或推论.

blocks.en: Some RoboDojo tasks require episode-specific checklist construction. For Arrange Largest Number , the number of digit-placement stages varies between four and five; we infer this count from up to three early observations using independent VLM queries followed by majority voting, and instantiate the corresponding checklist before boundary annotation. For tasks with a fixed semantic structure, such as Spell RoboDojo , the checklist is fixed in advance. Thus, the VLM annotator localizes transitions between predefined semantic stages rather than freely generating the task decomposition.
blocks.zh: 一些机器人 道场任务需要针对各集的核对表构建. 对于排列最大数字,数字定位阶段的数目在四到五个之间不等;我们通过独立的VLM查询,然后进行多数表决,推断出从最多到三个早期的观测结果,并在边界注释之前将相应的核对清单即时进行。 对于Spell RoboDojo 等具有固定语义结构的任务,核对表是事先固定的. 因此,VLM注释器将预定义语义阶段之间的过渡本地化,而不是自由生成任务分解.

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Offline subtask annotation
blocks.zh: 算法 1 离线子任务注释

blocks.en: Canonicalization. The offline annotation procedure above produces right-open segment ends paired with subtask text for each episode. Before constructing semantic supervision, we canonicalize these segments to remove annotation gaps. An unlabelled interval is not retained as a separate segment, because entering and leaving such a gap would otherwise create two artificial semantic transitions. Leading and internal gaps are therefore absorbed into the following labelled segment, while trailing gaps are absorbed into the final labelled segment, ensuring that each semantic stage boundary induces exactly one transition.
blocks.zh: 加农化. 上面的离线注解程序产生右开部分结尾,每集都与子任务文本对齐. 在构建语义学监督之前,我们对这些部分进行了细化,以消除注释空白. 未加标签的间隔不作为单独的段保留,因为进出这样的间隔,否则会产生两个人工语义过渡. 因此,铅和内部差距被吸收到以下标记段,而后面的差距则被吸收到最后标记段,确保每个语义阶段边界都精确地诱导一次过渡。

blocks.en: The memory increment is computed positionally: we take the longest common prefix of the two item lists and emit the remaining suffix of m t m_{t} . Cumulative memory only grows at the tail, and a set-keyed difference erases a genuine second completion whenever two subtasks share a sentence. On this corpus the set-keyed variant produced an empty increment for 46 % 46\% and 57 % 57\% of UPDATE frames on two tasks, which trains the model to emit UPDATE and then write nothing.
blocks.zh: 内存增量是计算位置的: 我们使用两个项目列表中最长的常用前缀, 并释放 m t m_{t} 的剩余后缀 。 累积内存只生长在尾部,当两个子任务共享一个句子时,一个设置的键差会抹去一个真正的第二个完成. 在该套件上,设置键的变体在两个任务上产生了46 % 46% 和57 % 57 % 的 UPDATE 帧的空增量,它训练该模型以发布 UPDATE,然后写不出来 。

blocks.en: Boundary-aware sampling. Only frames on the replanning phase are eligible. They are partitioned into UPDATE frames, hard KEEP frames one replanning interval before or after an UPDATE , and the remaining random KEEP frames. Hard KEEP frames are visually close to a transition but do not yet support advancing the subtask, so they are where a spurious UPDATE is most likely. Each semantic batch draws 2 2 frames from each pool. The training split holds 197,617 197{,}617 eligible frames, 9.19 % 9.19\% of them UPDATE ; the sampler replays the small pools and subsamples the large one so the model sees a 1 : 1 : 1 1{:}1{:}1 ratio.
